# cr-ci set-secrets.sh (dry-run) project=example-project region=us-central1
# dry-run: nothing is changed; '?' lines are read-only checks, assumed to find nothing
# C5/C9: App private key -> cr-runner-gh-app-private-key
+ gcloud secrets versions add cr-runner-gh-app-private-key --project=example-project --data-file=- --format=none < app-key.pem
# C5/C9: webhook secret -> cr-runner-gh-webhook-secret (one trailing newline stripped)
+ gcloud secrets versions add cr-runner-gh-webhook-secret --project=example-project --data-file=- --format=none < hook-secret
# done
